sections.Profile:
The "Harley Davidson" pinball machine, released by Bally in February 1991, features a design by Barry Oursler and Mark Sprenger. This solid-state game utilizes the Williams WPC system, marking the first Bally machine to do so. The playfield artwork includes iconic Harley-Davidson imagery, such as a fuel tank and handlebars, creating an immersive biker-themed experience.
